title: Ashur ki Shab Zainab ne Kaha Aye Raat Zara Aahista Guzar
body:
Ashur ki shab Zainab ne kaha aye raat zara aahista guzar
Ehsaan tera mujhpar hoga aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas e alam bardaar abhi-talwaar pa saiqal karte hai
Kal unko hai jouhar dikhlaana-aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal pyaase barati aayenge-qaasim ki shaadi kal hogi
Hojayegi kal bewaa kubra aye-raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Suljhate baithi hai madar-Akbar ki uljhi zulfo ko
Maloom nahi kal kia hoga-aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ke haatho par Asghar-kal teer gale par khayenge
Hojayega kal khali jhula-aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jee bhar ke Zainab dekhle-aaj apne bhai ka chehra
Kat jayega kal Sarwar ka gala-aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Lut jayenge kal khaime saare jaljayegi masnad ahmad ki
Hojayega kal ek sannata-aye raat zara aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis yaas se aur kis hasrat se-Zainab ye bayaan karti thi sayeed
Aahista guzar aye raat zara-aye raat zara aahista guzar
